entities.summary: Eugène François Bonaventure Bataille, better known by his artistic name Arthur Sapeck, was an important figure in the intellectual movements of the emerging French Third Republic, an emblematic figure of Les Hydropathes, then the Fumistes, Hirsutes, and Incohérents movements.
